title: 007 佛怒唐莲
content_zh:
“公子好武功。”中年文士站了起来，点点头。
萧瑟挥手：“不才不才，就是一个小戏法。我可不会武功。”
“不会武功？”中年文士一笑，“接下去的可都是险路，公子要不会武功，恐怕还是不要趟这滩浑水了。”
“怎么？”萧瑟一挑眉毛，“你要反悔。”
中年文士摇头：“我自然不会反悔，但是我说我不会动手，可是我的同伴们不同，他们可没有那么大的耐心。我想，他们此刻应该已经动手了。”
“哦？”萧瑟笑道，“可我们还有一个朋友，他虽然脑子不好使，但是手上功夫很好。你的同伴可不一定能占到便宜哦。”
“如果你知道我们是谁，就一定不会这么说。”中年文士傲然道。
萧瑟双手拢在袖中，懒洋洋地说道：“天外天，白发仙。往后倒推十二年，的确是一个能镇得住的名字。”
中年文士一怔，眼中寒光乍现，一贯淡然的声音忽然变得狠厉起来：“你是谁！你怎认得我！你怎会知道天外天！”
萧瑟耸耸肩：“这有何难认的，知道你们的人不多，但总归是有人知道的……”
萧瑟没有能够把话说完，因为中年文士此时已瞬间掠了过来，左手出爪正欲一把将他抓住。
唐莲急忙出手格挡，却被中年文士右手玉剑一击逼退。瞬间中年文士已经一把抓住了萧瑟的衣领：“你得跟我们走！”
萧瑟一脸无辜道：“可我明明赢了。”
中年文士冷笑一声：“可你既然知道天外天，那就知道我们是怎样的人。”说罢，他便一把将萧瑟拉起，往外掠去。唐莲欲追，刚刚中年文士身边的侍从立刻提剑迎了上来，将他挡了回去。
可萧瑟却冲着那边一直冷眼看着的冥侯月姬喊道：“十三年前，望衣楼内的红衣血案，凶手他是……”
“什么！”月姬立刻从桌子上跳了下来。
冥侯也猛地转身，握紧了手中的巨刃。
而此时萧瑟却已经被中年文士抓着，掠到了美人庄外。
冥侯和月姬丝毫没有犹豫，急忙跟了上去。那几名侍从也转过来阻拦他们。可月姬腰间银光一闪，冥侯手中巨刃猛地一挥，那几人顿时不是被割破了喉咙就是被拦腰砍成了两截。
“好大的杀性！”天女蕊都忍不住惊呼。

唐莲皱了皱眉：“我跟他们交手过两次，却第一次看他们的杀性如此之重。萧瑟刚刚那句话究竟什么意思？”
天女蕊摇头：“望衣楼红衣血案，那是十三年前的一桩迷案，不知道你那同伴为何忽然提及此事。那现在我们怎么办，追上去么？”
唐莲想了想，摇头：“不。红衣血案想必和冥侯月姬有关，萧瑟是故意引那白发人带走他的，然后他再引去冥侯月姬，为的是引起他们的争斗。我们现在去找雷无桀！”
“雷无桀又是谁？在哪？”
“就在后院！他守着那事物，如果那白发人没有说谎的话，那么恐怕此刻的他……”
“轰！”一声剧烈的爆炸声突然传来，在场的人不由地捂住了耳朵。
“我乃江南霹雳堂雷家雷无桀！还有不敢死的要上来吗！”雷无桀站在黄金棺材之上，双手各握着一大把霹雳子，冲着下面的人大喊着，一副豪气干云的样子。
围绕着马车的一群黑袍人此时似乎也被他唬住了，略略往后退了几步。
雷无桀才终于重重地喘了一口气，刚刚他在马车中躲着，忽然感觉十几道阴冷的掌气从马车外传来，他急忙运起真气抵抗。却发现那十几道掌气诡异无比，绵柔而阴毒，他的真气与其一碰便立刻被化解融合，他感觉整个人被那十几道掌气压着，完全喘不过气来，无奈之下只得用尽浑身真气，双眼在一瞬间变得通红，身体上的重压顿时感觉轻了很多，他勉力站了起来，朝天怒吼了一声，终于将那十几道掌气弹了出去。但马车车篷也在瞬间分崩离析，雷无桀想也没想，就冲着外面扔出了一把霹雳子，才终于将那些人逼出了十步之外。
这时雷无桀才终于看清了那群人的模样，竟是清一色穿着黑色长袍的人，都没有拿着兵器但是露出的一双手却都无一例外的惨白无比。
“你们是谁？”雷无桀问道。
但是没有人回答他，为首的黑袍人手轻轻一挥，一瞬间他身后的八个人已经一跃而起，八只阴冷的鬼爪冲着他抓去，一只直取他的下盘，一只欲夺他的头颅，一只攻向他的后背，另一只掏向他的心脏，而另外四只，则欲直接锁住他的双手双脚。如果一个人被这样控制住的话，那么他必定只能死得不能再死了。可是一个人只有一双手，他如何抵挡八个人同时的进攻。除非他有三头八臂！
可是此刻的雷无桀此时真的变成了三头六臂，同时出现了四个雷无桀，他们背靠着背，形成了一个完美的防御姿势。
为首的黑袍人愣了一下：“好快的速度！”他仔细望向雷无桀，却见雷无桀整个人瞬间身上热气腾腾，一双瞳孔变得火红火红。
“火灼之术？难怪……”为首的黑袍人手轻轻一挥。
此时那先行而去的八个人的攻势已经被雷无桀全部地挡了回去，可瞬间再度又有八个人一跃而起，袭去的方向与刚刚一模一样。可是此时的雷无桀却来不及抵挡了，但此时，却从他身后飞出了一朵莲花。
妖冶的，鬼魅的，夜色之莲。
莲花在空中瞬间炸裂了开来，七瓣花瓣顿时冲着七个人袭去，它的速度奇快，那七个黑袍人丝毫不怀疑这片鬼魅的花瓣能轻易地刺穿他们的头颅，因为他们都听过这件暗器的名字——佛怒唐莲！唐门最可怕的暗器之一，分为千瓣莲、重台莲、复瓣莲以及七瓣莲。这一朵只是七瓣莲，否则他们甚至连躲的机会都没有！所以他们立刻急退。
但还有一人！那个人没有退，他右手急取雷无桀的心脏，只要再往前一寸就能了断了他的命。但是他却没有再往前一步的机会了，因为一个身影从雷无桀身后一跃而起，手中光芒闪耀，仿佛握着一束月光，那束月光在瞬间就将那只鬼爪直接砍断了！随即那身影右脚一抬，将那人用力地踢飞了出去，随即稳稳地落在了棺材之上。
“唐莲。”为首的黑衣人皱了皱眉头，“你竟然还能活着从里面走出来。”

唐莲扭头看向雷无桀，问他：“怎么样？”
雷无桀擦了擦身上的汗，此刻他的整个人仿佛燃烧了起来一样，不住地往外冒着热气，一双眸子通红通红，他呼了口气：“这功夫我也是刚练成不久，还不够熟练。现在好了，打他十个八个不是问题。”
“好大的口气。”为首的黑袍人冷笑道，“可火灼之术乃是燃烧自己心中之火，以短暂获得神力之术。你的薪柴，又能燃烧多久呢？”
“燃烧多久我不知道，但是打你们这帮人不人鬼不鬼的家伙，还是可以的。”雷无桀向前踏上一步。
“好大的口气。”为首的黑袍人却只是冷笑。
唐莲忽然伸手拦住了雷无桀，雷无桀困惑地望向他，却见唐莲伸手一指夜空，说道：“你看。”
雷无桀抬头，只望见一个满月正挂在空中，问道：“怎么了？”
唐莲说道：“你觉得有什么异样吗？”
雷无桀瞪大了眼睛仔细看了一会儿后犹豫地说道：“倒像是纸糊的一般……”
唐莲叹了口气：“今天是二十二，天空中挂着的本应该是一轮下弦月，又怎么会出现满月呢。”
“师兄的意思是……”
“这是孤虚之术！所谓孤虚之术，是一种邪门阵法，孤虚阵中的人就仿佛进入了一个梦境一般。接下来，你不能相信你所看到的一切，也一定要相信你所看到的一切！”唐莲说道。
雷无桀苦笑：“师兄你说得是什么啊，我听不懂啊。”
“小心！”唐莲忽然望向雷无桀地脚下怒喝一声。
雷无桀猛地低头一看，只见棺材中伸出了无数只枯烂惨白的手，正欲抓住他的双腿。雷无桀急忙一跃而起，可半空中却另有一只鬼爪正直掏他的心脏，他一拳打出，却像是打在了虚空中一般，全身的力道都落了空。他急忙稳住气息，才保住了平衡，晃晃悠悠地落在了地上。他从小习武，也见过不少高手，可这般诡异可怖的阵法却是第一次见到，他背后出了一阵冷汗，转头望向唐莲：“师兄！”
却见唐莲微微皱着眉头，紧闭着双眼。
雷无桀喊道：“师兄！你也不要就这样放弃啊。”
正当他怒喊的时候，唐莲手一挥，袖中一支朱颜小箭已经破空而出，向着雷无桀身后一只忽然出现的鬼爪飞去，瞬间洞穿了那只手掌。雷无桀只听见一声惨呼，回头望去，却见那只鬼爪已经消失，地上却留下一滩鲜明的血迹，不由惊道：“师兄你是怎么知道这次这个是真的。”
唐莲依旧闭着双眼，眉头微皱似乎在凝神听着什么：“孤虚之中，你所看到的不一定是真实的，但是无数杀机却藏在这不真实之中。所有这个时候，你需要放弃你的眼睛，用你的耳朵去感受。听风辨位是雪月城的必修课程之一，今日我就先教给你了。所谓听风辨位，在于这个‘风’字。天地偌大，风无数不在。而孤虚最大的弱点就是他将隔绝一切外切的声音，所以在孤虚之中，你只许仔细聆听，当你身边那阵风被撕裂的时候，就是敌人的武器撕开风的声音，那个时候，就是他暴露出自己位置的时候！”唐莲说完后一跃而起，竟在半空中将一个黑袍人一把拉了出来，手中指尖刃流转，一下子割破了对方的喉咙，随即将他一脚踢在了地上。
而此时雷无桀双手狂舞，浑身上下舞出了一个完美的圆，将那些试图靠近的鬼爪无论真假全都挡了出去，而随即也闭上了眼睛。他努力凝神，初时只听耳边狂风乱舞，那正是自己舞出的拳风，而再仔细辨别，却能听出自己拳风之外，却是一股平稳安和的风在缓缓流动的声音，而忽然间，有什么撕开这阵平缓的风。雷无桀心中一动，冲着那个方向挥出了一记无方拳。只听一身惨叫，一个黑袍人的身影显现了出来，吐了一口鲜血，倒在了地上。

“天赋异禀！”唐莲赞道。
雷无桀睁开了眼睛，笑道：“毕竟从小习武，听觉也是练了许久的。”正当他得意的时候，一只手忽然从地下伸了出来，一把抓住了他的脚踝、雷无桀一惊，却见一支朱颜小箭破空而出，刺入了土中，那只手便立刻失去了力道。
“可惜心智不熟。”唐莲叹了口气。
content_en:
"Young Master is good at martial arts." The middle-aged scribe stood up and nodded.
Xiao Se waved his hand: "No talent, just a little trick. I don't know martial arts."
"Don't know martial arts?" The middle-aged scribe smiled, "What follows is a dangerous road. If the young master doesn't know martial arts, I'm afraid it's better not to go through this muddy water."
"What?" Xiao Se raised his eyebrows, "You want to regret it."
The middle-aged scribe shook his head: "Of course I won't regret it, but I said I wouldn't take action, but my companions are different. They don't have that much patience. I think they should have taken action by now."
"Oh?" Xiao Se smiled, "But we also have a friend. Although he is not very smart, he is very good at it. Your companion may not be able to take advantage."
"If you knew who we were, you would never say that." The middle-aged scribe said proudly.
Xiao Se clasped his hands in his sleeves and said lazily: "Tianwaitian, White-haired Immortal. Looking back twelve years, it is indeed a name that can be suppressed."
The middle-aged scribe was startled, a cold light suddenly appeared in his eyes, and his usually calm voice suddenly became fierce: "Who are you! How do you recognize me! How do you know that the sky is beyond the sky!"
Xiao Se shrugged: "What's so hard to recognize? Not many people know you, but there are always people who know..."
Xiao Se couldn't finish his words, because the middle-aged scribe had rushed over in an instant, and he was about to grab him with his claws on his left hand.
Tang Lian hurriedly moved to block, but was forced back by a blow from the middle-aged scribe's jade sword in his right hand. In an instant, the middle-aged scribe had grabbed Xiao Se's collar: "You have to come with us!"
Xiao Se said innocently: "But I obviously won."
The middle-aged scribe sneered: "But since you know Tianwaitian, then you know what kind of people we are." After that, he pulled Xiao Se up and swept away. Tang Lian wanted to pursue him, but the attendant who had just been beside the middle-aged scribe immediately came up to him with his sword and blocked him back.
But Xiao Se shouted to Minghou Yueji, who had been watching coldly over there: "Thirteen years ago, the murder case of red clothes in Wangyi Tower, the murderer was..."
"What!" Yue Ji immediately jumped down from the table.
Minghou also turned around suddenly and tightened his grip on the giant blade in his hand.
But at this time, Xiao Se had been caught by the middle-aged scribe and taken outside the beauty village.
Minghou and Yueji did not hesitate at all and hurriedly followed. The attendants also turned around to stop them. But there was a flash of silver light on Yue Ji's waist, and the giant blade in Ming Hou's hand swung violently, and those people either had their throats cut or were chopped into two pieces at the waist.
"It's so murderous!" Tiannu Rui couldn't help but exclaimed.
Tang Lian frowned: "I have fought against them twice, but this is the first time I have seen them so murderous. What did Xiao Se mean by what he just said?"
Tiannu Rui shook her head: "The Wangyilou Red Clothes Murder Case was a mysterious case thirteen years ago. I don't know why your companion suddenly mentioned it. So what should we do now, should we catch up?"
Tang Lian thought for a moment and shook her head: "No. The murder in red must be related to Marquis Yueji. Xiao Se deliberately led the white-haired man to take him away, and then he lured Marquis Yueji away in order to cause a fight between them. Let's go find Lei Wujie now!"
"Who is Lei Wujie? Where is he?"
"It's in the backyard! He's guarding that thing. If the white-haired man didn't lie, then I'm afraid he..."
"Boom!" A violent explosion suddenly came, and everyone present couldn't help but cover their ears.
"I am Lei Wujie of the Lei Family of Jiangnan Perak Hall! Is there anyone else who dares to die? Come up!" Lei Wujie stood on top of the golden coffin, holding a handful of thunderbolts in each hand, shouting at the people below, with a proud look.
The group of men in black robes surrounding the carriage seemed to be frightened by him and took a few steps back.
Lei Wujie finally took a deep breath. Just now he was hiding in the carriage, and suddenlySuddenly, he felt a dozen cold palms coming from outside the carriage, and he hurriedly gathered his energy to resist. However, he found that the dozens of palm qi were extremely strange, soft and sinister, and his true energy was immediately dissolved and fused as soon as he touched them. He felt that his whole body was being pressed by the dozen palm qi, and he was completely out of breath. In desperation, he had to use up all his true energy. His eyes turned red in an instant, and the weight on his body suddenly felt much lighter. He managed to stand up, roared to the sky, and finally flicked out the dozen palm qi. But the hood of the carriage also fell apart in an instant. Lei Wujie threw a handful of thunderbolts outside without thinking, and finally forced those people ten steps away.
At this time, Lei Wujie finally saw the appearance of the group of people. They were all wearing black robes. None of them were holding weapons, but the exposed hands were all extremely pale.
"Who are you?" Lei Wujie asked.
But no one answered him. The leading man in black robe waved his hand lightly, and in an instant the eight people behind him jumped up. Eight cold ghost claws were grabbing at him. One was grabbing his lower body, one was trying to snatch his head, one was attacking his back, the other was digging for his heart, and the other four were trying to directly lock his hands and feet. If a person is controlled like this, then he will definitely die. But if a person only has one pair of hands, how can he resist the attacks of eight people at the same time? Unless he has three heads and eight arms!
But at this moment, Lei Wujie really turned into a man with three heads and six arms, and four Lei Wujie appeared at the same time. They were back to back, forming a perfect defensive posture.
The leading man in black robe was stunned for a moment: "What a fast speed!" He looked at Lei Wujie carefully, and saw that Lei Wujie's whole body was instantly filled with heat, and his pupils turned fiery red.
"Fire-scorching technique? No wonder..." The leader in black robe waved his hand lightly.
At this time, the offensive of the eight people who had gone ahead had been blocked by Lei Wujie, but in an instant, eight more people jumped up again, attacking in the same direction as before. But at this time, Lei Wujie had no time to resist, but at this time, a lotus flower flew out from behind him.
Enchanting, ghostly, lotus of the night.
The lotus exploded in the air instantly, and its seven petals immediately attacked the seven people. Its speed was extremely fast. The seven men in black robes had no doubt that this ghostly petal could easily pierce their heads, because they had all heard the name of this hidden weapon-Buddha's Furious Tang Lotus! One of the most terrifying hidden weapons in the Tang Sect is divided into thousand-petal lotus, heavy-petal lotus, double-petal lotus and seven-petal lotus. This one is just a seven-petaled lotus, otherwise they wouldn't even have a chance to hide! So they retreated immediately.
But there is one more person! The man didn't retreat. He grabbed Lei Wujie's heart with his right hand. If he moved forward even an inch, he would be dead. But he had no chance to take another step forward, because a figure jumped up from behind Lei Wujie, the light shining in his hand, as if he was holding a beam of moonlight, and the moonlight cut off the ghost claw in an instant! Then the figure raised his right foot and kicked the man away hard, and then landed firmly on the coffin.
"Tang Lian." The leader of the men in black frowned, "You can still walk out of it alive."
Tang Lian turned to look at Lei Wujie and asked him, "How is it?"
Lei Wujie wiped the sweat from his body. At this moment, his whole body seemed to be on fire, steam was constantly coming out, and his eyes were red. He exhaled: "I have just practiced this skill not long ago, and I am not proficient enough. Now I am better. It is not a problem to hit him ten or eight times."
"What a loud tone." The leader of the black-robed man sneered, "But the fire burning technique is to burn the fire in one's heart to temporarily gain divine power. How long can your firewood burn?"
"I don't know how long it will burn,But it's still okay to beat you guys who are neither human nor ghosts. "Lei Wujie took a step forward.
“What a loud tone. "The leading man in black robe just sneered.
Tang Lian suddenly reached out and stopped Lei Wujie. Lei Wujie looked at him in confusion, but saw Tang Lian pointing at the night sky and saying, "Look. "
Lei Wujie looked up and saw a full moon hanging in the sky, and asked, "What's wrong? "
Tang Lian said: "Do you feel anything strange? "
Lei Wujie stared at it carefully for a while and said hesitantly: "It looks like it's made of paper..."
Tang Lian sighed: "Today is the 22nd, and the moon hanging in the sky should be the waning moon, so how can there be a full moon. "
"Senior brother means..."
"This is the art of Guxu! The so-called Guxu Technique is an evil formation. People in the Guxu Formation seem to have entered a dream. Next, you can’t believe everything you see, and you must believe everything you see! Tang Lian said.
Lei Wujie smiled bitterly: "Brother, what are you talking about? I don't understand. "
"careful! Tang Lian suddenly looked at Lei Wujie's feet and shouted angrily.
Lei Wujie suddenly looked down and saw countless withered and pale hands stretching out from the coffin, trying to grab his legs. Lei Wujie jumped up in a hurry, but there was another ghost claw in mid-air that was digging out his heart. He punched out, but it was as if he punched into the void, and all the strength in his body was lost. He hurriedly stabilized his breath, maintained his balance, and landed on the ground unsteadily. He had practiced martial arts since he was a child and had seen many masters, but this was the first time he saw such a weird and terrifying formation. A cold sweat broke out on his back, and he turned to look at Tang Lian: "Senior brother! "
But Tang Lian frowned slightly and closed her eyes tightly.
Lei Wujie shouted: “Senior brother! Don't give up just like this. "
Just as he was shouting angrily, Tang Lian waved his hand, and a small red arrow in his sleeve shot out of the air and flew towards a ghost claw that suddenly appeared behind Lei Wujie, instantly piercing the palm. Lei Wujie only heard a scream and looked back, only to see that the ghost claw had disappeared, leaving a bright pool of blood on the ground. He couldn't help but said in shock: "Brother, how do you know this is real this time. "
Tang Lian still had her eyes closed, her brows slightly furrowed as if she was listening intently: "In loneliness, what you see may not be real, but countless murderous intentions are hidden in this unreality. All this time, you need to give up your eyes and use your ears to feel. Distinguishing position by listening to the wind is one of the compulsory courses in Xueyue City.
